roadmap.name: Data-engineering
roadmap.description: Lộ trình trở thành Data Engineer - người xây dựng và quản lý data infrastructure, pipelines, data warehouse để hỗ trợ analytics và data science. Bắt đầu từ nền tảng programming, phát triển kỹ năng SQL/Python, big data technologies (Spark, Kafka), data pipelines (Airflow, dbt), cloud data services, đến data governance và modern data stack.

stages.name: Foundation
stages.description: Nắm vững nền tảng programming, Linux và computer science cho data engineering.

skills.name: Programming Fundamentals
whatYouWillLearn: Python basics: variables, types, operators, control flow
Python data structures: lists, dicts, sets, tuples
File I/O: reading/writing files (CSV, JSON, text)
Modules và packages: import, pip, virtual environments
Command line proficiency: bash basics, navigation
Version control: Git basics (init, add, commit, branch)
Data types: primitive vs complex, when to use what
Functions vs classes: when to use what

nextSkill.name: Linux & Command Line
nextSkill.description: Nắm vững Linux cho data engineering.

skills.name: Linux & Command Line
whatYouWillLearn: File operations: ls, cd, mkdir, rm, cp, mv, find, grep
Text processing: cat, less, head, tail, awk, sed
Process management: ps, top, kill, nohup
Shell scripting: bash, variables, loops, conditionals
Networking basics: curl, wget, ping, dig

nextSkill.name: Computer Science for Data Engineering
nextSkill.description: Nắm vững CS basics cho data workloads.

skills.name: Computer Science for Data Engineering
whatYouWillLearn: Cấu trúc dữ liệu: Array, Linked List, Stack, Queue, Hash Table, Tree
Big O notation: O(1), O(log n), O(n), O(n log n)
Data structures trong Python: list, dict, set, deque
Hash tables: hashing, collisions, use cases
Trees: binary tree, B-tree, LSM tree (for databases)
Memory management: stack, heap, garbage collection

nextSkill.name: SQL Mastery
nextSkill.description: Thành thạo SQL cho data engineering.

stages.name: SQL & Database Mastery
stages.description: Thành thạo SQL nâng cao và database concepts cho data engineering.

skills.name: SQL Mastery
whatYouWillLearn: SQL fundamentals: SELECT, FROM, WHERE, ORDER BY, LIMIT
JOINs: INNER, LEFT, RIGHT, FULL OUTER, CROSS, SELF
Aggregation: GROUP BY, HAVING, COUNT, SUM, AVG, MIN, MAX
Subqueries: in SELECT, FROM, WHERE, correlated
Window functions: ROW_NUMBER, RANK, DENSE_RANK, LAG, LEAD
Window functions: SUM, AVG, COUNT OVER partitions
Date functions: DATEADD, DATEDIFF, DATE_TRUNC, EXTRACT
Performance: EXPLAIN ANALYZE, indexes, query optimization

nextSkill.name: Database Systems
nextSkill.description: Hiểu các hệ thống database cho data engineering.

skills.name: Database Systems
whatYouWillLearn: RDBMS architecture: storage, query processing, transaction management
PostgreSQL: advanced features, extensions, performance tuning
PostgreSQL: JSONB, arrays, window functions, CTEs
MySQL: differences from PostgreSQL, InnoDB engine
Indexing: B-Tree, Hash, GIN, GiST, composite, partial, covering
Query optimization: execution plans, statistics, vacuum
NoSQL databases: types (Document, Key-Value, Column, Graph)
Redis: data types, use cases, caching patterns
Database comparison: when to use what
Database administration basics: backup, restore, monitoring

nextSkill.name: Data Modeling
nextSkill.description: Thiết kế data models cho analytics và warehousing.

skills.name: Data Modeling
whatYouWillLearn: Data modeling process: requirements → conceptual → logical → physical
Conceptual modeling: entities, relationships, ER diagrams
Physical modeling: tables, columns, indexes, partitioning
Dimension tables: types (缓慢变化维度 Type 1, 2, 3)
Data warehouse modeling: star vs snowflake vs vault
Data vault modeling: hubs, links, satellites
One Big Table (OBT): when to use
Modeling for different workloads: OLTP vs OLAP
Data modeling tools: ERD, dbdiagram.io, DBeaver
Data dictionary: business glossary, metadata management
